active_drive_window.definition: viewer.run entry through exit; callbacks require host receipt within [start, end); callback lifecycle is separate

clocks.preparation_age: render preparation host time minus latest callback host receipt
clocks.run_measurements_host_elapsed: separate duration from the session monotonic clock
clocks.sensor: CARLA image frame and timestamp seconds
clocks.summary_age: summary host time minus latest callback host receipt

limitations.latency_scope: host callback receipt to render preparation only

loop_correlation.interpretation: same-loop spans, not independent maxima; absent spans are unmeasured; mode at completion may follow a transition within the loop; not exhaustive or a mode-specific Display FPS measurement; fallback input_collection may nest in manual_control_preparation
loop_correlation.scope: active viewer window; incomplete/aborted loops excluded
loop_correlation.storage: one slowest loop and one pending loop; fixed segment names

callback_counts.definition: every camera callback received during that lifecycle

render_preparations.definition: prepared, updated, repeated, and no-image counters

timing_definitions.after_display_flip: post-flip hook, including P5 presentation marking
timing_definitions.audio: turn-signal audio including fresh light RPC; optional vehicle audio when enabled
timing_definitions.conversion.<role>: CARLA BGRA buffer to pygame surface
timing_definitions.draw: complete draw including camera composition and HUD
timing_definitions.driver_loop: event polling through completed FPS limiter
timing_definitions.mode_events: mode/view/indicator event handling, including toggle light RPCs

turn_signal_audio_timing_definitions.first_call: first observed call for each operation
turn_signal_audio_timing_definitions.subsequent_calls: all observed calls after the first for each operation

summary.mode_definition: canonical automation control mode at operation completion

overlap.activation_queries: also measured on activation checks outside post-control; do not subtract whole-run totals from post-control
overlap.draw: contains camera conversion, resize, mirror flip, blit, and HUD drawing
overlap.driver_loop: contains input, scheduler, control, render, display flip, and FPS limiter
overlap.input_collection: contains indicator_input_light_rpc when a Z/X event requires a fresh observation
overlap.manual_availability_refresh: contains activation_geometry_query, activation_bounding_box_getter and availability events; manual post-control only
overlap.manual_control_delivery: contains checked manual_batch_rpc_wait and response validation; excludes preparation and post-control
overlap.map_getter: legacy alias of waypoint_query; do not sum the two labels
overlap.post_control: contains manual_availability_refresh and persisted observation, including light_getter
overlap.scheduler: legacy scheduler and operation scheduler timing cover the same update call
overlap.traffic_light_observation: contains cached traffic-light getters and conditional actor lookup
overlap.turn_signal_audio_light_rpc: camera.timing_by_mode; subset of audio and alias of turn_signal_audio_timing light_state_rpc; independent of telemetry light_getter
overlap.vehicle_audio_update: subset of camera audio; cached-state model and preloaded grain launch; excludes pre-drive synthesis and exit fade
